notes.title: Update Description for Drunk Or Dead 2
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce a new update for Drunk Or Dead 2 with the following improvements:

Balance Adjustments:

Simplified difficulty modes for levels, making it easier to navigate and enjoy the game.
Sobering up is now slowed down, with the speed depending on the difficulty level chosen.
New Features:

The Online Bar is now accessible after completing the first mission. Connect and strategize with other players in this virtual hangout.
Bug Fixes:

Various fixes in locations and player mechanics to enhance the overall gameplay experience.
Dive back in and experience the improved balance and new features. Your feedback is invaluable as we continue to refine and expand the game. Enjoy!

notes.title: Drunk Or Dead 2 VR Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Step into the wild, post-apocalyptic world of Drunk Or Dead 2, where surviving a zombie outbreak is just another reason to party!

[previewyoutube=6sEVl8bbATA;full][/previewyoutube]

As a survivor, you'll embark on a hilarious, action-packed adventure, tackling bizarre and challenging missions. Whether it's battling hordes of zombies or brewing moonshine, every task is designed to test your wit, grit, and ability to think outside the box.

Drunk Or Dead 2 hits Steam Early Access on June 14th! Add us to your wishlist now and don't miss out on the discount!

How Can I Find Out More?
Join our Discord! Chat with our dev team and fellow fans about Drunk Or Dead 2, get the latest updates, and share your wildest ideas. Follow us on Twitter and Instagram to stay in the loop!
